newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian president Stoyanov formally takes over.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian president Stoyanov formally takes over.

text.p: Bulgaria's outgoing president Zhelyu Zhelev formally handed over to his successor Petar Stoyanov at a ceremony in Sofia on Wednesday.
Stoyanov took over command of the army from Zhelev, the first directly-elected head of state in Bulgaria's 1,300-year history, at a military parade outside the presidency.
Stoyanov, a 44-year-old divorce lawyer, inherits severe economic crisis and political deadlock that has prevented formation of a new government.
The opposition has held 15 days of street protests for quick elections and against formation of a new cabinet by the ex-communist Socialists, who have a majority in parliament.
Stoyanov, elected on the opposition ticket in presidential polls last November, backed calls for quick elections at his swearing-in ceremony in parliament last Sunday.
